$comment: Low Talk patch schema: the single source of truth for every synth parameter. Shared by the engine, language layer and UI. curve: linear | log (min > 0) | pow (value = min + (max-min)*t^exponent).

params.label: Legato
params.describes: On: overlapping notes slide without retriggering the envelopes (303-style). Off: every note retriggers.

params.label: Glide time
params.describes: Time to slide between notes. 0 is instant; 30-120 ms is a quick slide; above 300 ms is a slow swoop.

params.label: Octave
params.describes: Shifts the whole patch (oscillators and sub) by octaves.

params.label: Velocity sensitivity
params.describes: How much playing harder makes the sound louder. 0 ignores velocity.

params.label: Osc 1 wave
params.describes: Sine is pure and round; triangle is soft with a little edge; saw is bright and buzzy (classic bass); pulse is hollow and reedy; wavetable morphs between shapes with the position control.

params.label: Osc 1 semitones
params.describes: Pitch offset in semitones. +12/-12 adds an octave layer; +7 adds a fifth for a harder, organ-like tone.

params.label: Osc 1 fine tune
params.describes: Fine detune in cents. Small offsets between the two oscillators cause slow beating (Reese movement).

params.label: Osc 1 pulse width
params.describes: Only for the pulse wave. 0.5 is a hollow square; values near the ends are thin and nasal.

params.label: Osc 1 wavetable position
params.describes: Only for the wavetable wave. Sweeps sine (0) → triangle → saw → square → vocal/formant (1). Higher is brighter and more complex.

params.label: Osc 1 unison voices
params.describes: Number of stacked, detuned copies. 1 is tight and focused; 3-7 is wide, thick and buzzy.

params.label: Osc 1 unison detune
params.describes: Spread of the unison copies in cents. Low is subtle thickening; high is a dissonant, washy smear.

params.label: Osc 1 stereo spread
params.describes: How far the unison copies are panned. Only affects content above the mono crossover.

params.label: Osc 1 level
params.describes: Oscillator volume into the filter.

params.label: Osc 2 wave
params.describes: Sine is pure and round; triangle is soft with a little edge; saw is bright and buzzy (classic bass); pulse is hollow and reedy; wavetable morphs between shapes with the position control.

params.label: Osc 2 semitones
params.describes: Pitch offset in semitones. +12/-12 adds an octave layer; +7 adds a fifth for a harder, organ-like tone.

params.label: Osc 2 fine tune
params.describes: Fine detune in cents. Small offsets between the two oscillators cause slow beating (Reese movement).

params.label: Osc 2 pulse width
params.describes: Only for the pulse wave. 0.5 is a hollow square; values near the ends are thin and nasal.

params.label: Osc 2 wavetable position
params.describes: Only for the wavetable wave. Sweeps sine (0) → triangle → saw → square → vocal/formant (1). Higher is brighter and more complex.

params.label: Osc 2 unison voices
params.describes: Number of stacked, detuned copies. 1 is tight and focused; 3-7 is wide, thick and buzzy.

params.label: Osc 2 unison detune
params.describes: Spread of the unison copies in cents. Low is subtle thickening; high is a dissonant, washy smear.

params.label: Osc 2 stereo spread
params.describes: How far the unison copies are panned. Only affects content above the mono crossover.

params.label: Osc 2 level
params.describes: Oscillator volume into the filter.

params.label: FM amount
params.describes: A sine modulator phase-modulates osc 1. Low adds bell-like bite; high is metallic, clangy and aggressive.

params.label: FM ratio
params.describes: Modulator pitch relative to the note. Whole numbers (1, 2, 3) sound harmonic; in-between values sound metallic and inharmonic.

params.label: Sub wave
params.describes: Sine is pure weight; triangle adds a little audible edge on small speakers.

params.label: Sub octave
params.describes: Sub pitch below the played note. -1 is the usual; -2 is very deep rumble.

params.label: Sub level
params.describes: Clean mono sub that bypasses filter and distortion. More is heavier low end you feel more than hear.

params.label: Noise level
params.describes: White noise into the filter for grit, breath and attack texture. Keep low.

params.label: Pre-filter drive
params.describes: Warm saturation before the filter. Adds harmonics and thickness; the filter then rounds them off.

params.label: Filter type
params.describes: Low-pass is the classic 4-pole bass filter; band-pass removes lows and highs for a nasal, thin tone; formant makes vowel sounds ("yoy", "wow").

params.label: Filter cutoff
params.describes: Lower is darker and rounder; below ~300 Hz becomes muffled. In formant mode it shifts the vowel up or down.

params.label: Filter resonance
params.describes: Emphasis at the cutoff. Higher is squelchy and vocal (acid); near the top it whistles.

params.label: Filter key tracking
params.describes: How much the cutoff follows the played note. 1 keeps the tone consistent across the keyboard; 0 makes high notes darker.

params.label: Filter envelope amount
params.describes: How far the mod envelope sweeps the cutoff (±6 octaves). Positive gives a plucky "wow" at the start of each note.

params.label: Filter vowel
params.describes: Formant mode only: morphs through vowels A → E → I → O → U.

params.label: Distortion type
params.describes: Soft is warm tape/tube-like; hard is aggressive and buzzy; fold is metallic and growly; crush is lo-fi and digital.

params.label: Distortion drive
params.describes: How hard the distortion is pushed. More is dirtier, louder-feeling and more compressed.

params.label: Distortion mix
params.describes: Blend between clean and distorted signal.

params.label: Distortion tone
params.describes: Low-pass after the distortion. Lower tames fizz and harshness; higher keeps the bite.

params.label: Amp attack
params.describes: Fade-in time. Under 5 ms is punchy; longer is a swell.

params.label: Amp decay
params.describes: Time to fall to the sustain level. Short with low sustain makes a pluck.

params.label: Amp sustain
params.describes: Level while the key is held. 1 is a held organ-like bass; 0 is a pluck or 808 decay.

params.label: Amp release
params.describes: Fade-out after the key is released. Short is tight; long overlaps notes.

params.label: Mod attack
params.describes: Rise time of the mod envelope.

params.label: Mod decay
params.describes: Time for the mod envelope to fall to sustain. Short is plucky; long is a slow sweep.

params.label: Mod sustain
params.describes: Mod envelope level while the key is held.

params.label: Mod release
params.describes: Mod envelope fall time after release.

params.label: Pitch envelope amount
params.describes: Pitch offset at the start of each note, decaying to zero. +12 to +24 with a short decay gives an 808/kick-style punch.

params.label: Pitch envelope decay
params.describes: How quickly the pitch envelope falls back to the played note.

params.label: LFO 1 shape
params.describes: Sine and triangle are smooth wobbles; saws are rhythmic ramps; square jumps; sample & hold is random steps.

params.label: LFO 1 rate
params.describes: Speed when not tempo-synced. Under 1 Hz is slow drift; 2-8 Hz is wobble; above 10 Hz is buzz/growl.

params.label: LFO 1 tempo sync
params.describes: Locks the LFO to the tempo as a note length (1/8 is the classic dubstep wobble). "free" uses the rate in Hz.

params.label: LFO 1 retrigger
params.describes: On: the LFO restarts on every note, so each note moves the same way.

params.label: LFO 2 shape
params.describes: Sine and triangle are smooth wobbles; saws are rhythmic ramps; square jumps; sample & hold is random steps.

params.label: LFO 2 rate
params.describes: Speed when not tempo-synced. Under 1 Hz is slow drift; 2-8 Hz is wobble; above 10 Hz is buzz/growl.

params.label: LFO 2 tempo sync
params.describes: Locks the LFO to the tempo as a note length (1/8 is the classic dubstep wobble). "free" uses the rate in Hz.

params.label: LFO 2 retrigger
params.describes: On: the LFO restarts on every note, so each note moves the same way.

params.label: Mod 1 source
params.describes: Modulation source for this matrix slot.

params.label: Mod 1 destination
params.describes: Parameter this slot modulates. Pitch: ±1 = ±24 st; cutoff: ±1 = ±6 octaves; others: ±1 = full range.

params.label: Mod 1 amount
params.describes: Depth and direction of this modulation.

params.label: Chorus mix
params.describes: Stereo chorus on everything above the low cut. Wider, lusher, more 80s.

params.label: Chorus depth
params.describes: How much the chorus wobbles. High is seasick; low is a subtle widening.

params.label: Phaser mix
params.describes: Sweeping notches for a swirling, jet-like movement.

params.label: Phaser rate
params.describes: Speed of the phaser sweep.

params.label: Reverb mix
params.describes: Short room reverb on the upper range. Bass rarely wants much; a touch adds space.

params.label: Reverb size
params.describes: Small is a tight room; large is a longer tail.

params.label: FX low cut
params.describes: Effects (chorus, phaser, reverb) only process content above this frequency, keeping the low end clean and centred.

params.label: EQ low shelf
params.describes: Boost or cut below ~100 Hz. Boost for weight, cut for a leaner bass.

params.label: EQ mid
params.describes: Bell boost or cut at the mid frequency. Cutting around 300-500 Hz removes mud/boxiness.

params.label: EQ mid frequency
params.describes: Centre frequency of the mid band.

params.label: EQ high shelf
params.describes: Boost or cut above ~5 kHz. Boost for air and bite, cut to tame fizz.

params.label: Output gain
params.describes: Level into the always-on limiter.

params.label: Mono crossover
params.describes: Everything below this frequency is summed to mono so the low end stays solid on any system.
